Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, c As Range, s As String, f As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "data"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("Region", "Product", "Amount")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("East", "Pen", 10)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("East", "Ink", 20)
    ws.Range("A4:C4").Value = Array("West", "Pen", 30)
    ws.Range("A5:C5").Value = Array("West", "Ink", 40)
    ws.Range("A6:C6").Value = Array("West", "Pad", 50)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws)
    ws.Name = "report"
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, "data!R1C1:R6C3").CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("A3"), "P")
    pt.PivotFields("Region").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.PivotFields("Product").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("Amount"), "Sum of Amount", xlSum
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
    Case 1
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
        pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtBottom
    Case 2
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
        pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtBottom: pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtTop
    Case 3
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlOutlineRow
        pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtBottom
    Case 4
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlTabularRow
        pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtBottom
    Case 5
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
        pt.PivotFields("Region").LayoutSubtotalLocation = xlAtBottom: pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtTop
    Case 6
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
        pt.SubtotalLocation 3
    Case 7
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
        s = TypeName(pt.SubtotalLocation(xlAtBottom))
    Case 8
        pt.RowAxisLayout xlCompactRow
        pt.PivotFields("Product").Orientation = xlColumnField: pt.SubtotalLocation xlAtBottom
    End Select
    For Each f In pt.RowFields: s = s & "|" & f.Name & "=" & f.LayoutSubtotalLocation: Next
    s = s & "|"
    For Each c In pt.TableRange1.Cells: s = s & c.Address(False, False) & ":" & c.Text & ";": Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 8
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
